types.name: strategies.v1.Backtest
types.doc: Backtest is one backtest of a version.

fields.name: backtest_id
fields.doc: Public backtest ID.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: The version backtested.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status.

fields.name: window
fields.doc: The simulated window.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the backtest was started.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When it finished or failed. Omitted before.

fields.name: report
fields.doc: The result. Set only when status is DONE.

fields.name: failure
fields.doc: Why it failed. Empty unless status is FAILED.

types.name: strategies.v1.BacktestMetrics
types.doc: BacktestMetrics are the results of a bot over one period.

fields.name: return_percent
fields.doc: Return over the period, in percent, for example "4.2" or "-1.5".

fields.name: max_drawdown_percent
fields.doc: Largest fall from a peak, in percent.

fields.name: trades
fields.doc: Trades made.

fields.name: win_rate_percent
fields.doc: Share of closed trades that made a profit, in percent.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc: Fees paid, in the quote asset.

fields.name: exposure_percent
fields.doc: Share of the period the bot held a position, in percent.

types.name: strategies.v1.BacktestReport
types.doc: BacktestReport is the result of a finished backtest.

fields.name: fidelity
fields.doc: How closely the simulation follows live trading, as a short label.

fields.name: evidence_grade
fields.doc: How much the result can be trusted, as a short grade.

fields.name: period
fields.doc: The period the bot was tuned on.

fields.name: held_back_period
fields.doc: The most recent months, held back from tuning.

fields.name: metrics
fields.doc: Results over period.

fields.name: held_back_metrics
fields.doc: Results over held_back_period.

fields.name: baselines
fields.doc: The baselines over period: buy-and-hold and cash.

fields.name: attempts
fields.doc:
Backtests run so far for this bot's family of versions. Many attempts
 make a good result more likely to be luck.

fields.name: trades
fields.doc: The first trades, oldest first: at most 20. report_url lists all of them.

fields.name: data_gaps
fields.doc: Spans without market data, oldest first.

fields.name: warnings
fields.doc: What to keep in mind when reading the result.

fields.name: report_url
fields.doc: The full report on the website.

types.name: strategies.v1.BacktestSummary
types.doc: BacktestSummary is the headline of a version's latest backtest.

fields.name: backtest_id
fields.doc: Public backtest ID.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Its status.

fields.name: metrics
fields.doc: Results over the tuning period. Set only when status is DONE.

fields.name: held_back_metrics
fields.doc: Results over the held-back period. Set only when status is DONE.

fields.name: attempts
fields.doc: Backtests run so far for this bot's family of versions.

fields.name: report_url
fields.doc: The full report on the website. Set only when status is DONE.

types.name: strategies.v1.BacktestTrade
types.doc: BacktestTrade is one trade a backtest made.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: When the trade happened, in simulated time.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: Market, for example BTC/USDT.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side.

fields.name: price
fields.doc: Price, as an exact decimal in the quote asset.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc: Quantity, as an exact decimal in the base asset.

fields.name: fee
fields.doc: Fee paid.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: The reason the bot gave for the order.

types.name: strategies.v1.Baseline
types.doc: Baseline is a simple strategy a backtest is compared with.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Baseline name: buy_and_hold or cash.

fields.name: metrics
fields.doc: Its results over the same period.

types.name: strategies.v1.Bot
types.doc: Bot is one bot of the caller.

fields.name: bot_id
fields.doc: Public bot ID.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The bot's name.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public ID of the bot's own subaccount, which the caller's main account
 owns.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current state.

fields.name: status_reason
fields.doc: Why the bot is in its state. Empty when RUNNING.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: The version it runs.

fields.name: profit_and_loss
fields.doc:
Profit and loss since deployment, as an exact decimal in quote_asset:
 negative for a loss, for example "-12.5".

fields.name: last_decision_at
fields.doc: When the bot last decided. Omitted before its first decision.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the bot was deployed.

fields.name: quote_asset
fields.doc: Quote asset of the bot's markets, for example USDT.

types.name: strategies.v1.BotBalance
types.doc: BotBalance is one asset balance of a bot's subaccount.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Asset symbol, for example USDT.

fields.name: free
fields.doc: Balance free to use, as an exact decimal.

fields.name: locked
fields.doc: Balance held by open orders, as an exact decimal.

types.name: strategies.v1.BotCapDetail
types.doc: BotCapDetail explains BOT_CAP_REACHED.

fields.name: vip_tier
fields.doc: The caller's current VIP tier.

fields.name: bot_cap
fields.doc: The most bots the tier allows at once.

fields.name: bots
fields.doc: Bots the caller runs now, deploying ones included.

fields.name: next_vip_tier
fields.doc: The next VIP tier with a higher cap. Zero when no tier lifts it.

fields.name: next_bot_cap
fields.doc: The cap of next_vip_tier. Zero when no tier lifts it.

types.name: strategies.v1.BotDecision
types.doc: BotDecision is one handler call of a bot.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.doc: When the decision was made.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: The event that woke the bot, for example "schedule mon 09:00 UTC".

fields.name: orders
fields.doc:
The orders the bot asked for, each with its reason, in the shape the
 manifest's behaviour examples use. Empty when it decided to do nothing.

fields.name: logs
fields.doc: The bot's log lines from the call, oldest first.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.doc:
What the bot saw: prices, indicator values, balances and open orders at
 the event.

types.name: strategies.v1.BotError
types.doc: BotError is one failed handler call of a bot.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: When the call failed.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: The event that woke the bot.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: The error.

types.name: strategies.v1.BotLogEntry
types.doc: BotLogEntry is one line of a bot's log.

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: Position in the bot's log, increasing.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: When it was written.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What it records.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: The line.

types.name: strategies.v1.BotOrder
types.doc: BotOrder is one open order of a bot.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Public order ID.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: Market, for example BTC/USDT.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Order type, for example limit or stop_loss.

fields.name: price
fields.doc:
Limit or trigger price, as an exact decimal in the quote asset. Empty for
 a market order.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc: Quantity, as an exact decimal in the base asset.

fields.name: filled_quantity
fields.doc: Quantity filled so far.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the order was placed.

types.name: strategies.v1.DataGap
types.doc: DataGap is a span with missing market data.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: Market, for example BTC/USDT.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.doc: Candle timeframe, for example 1h.

fields.name: window
fields.doc: The span without data.

types.name: strategies.v1.DeployProposalSummary
types.doc:
DeployProposalSummary is what a deploy proposal binds, for showing beside
 its link.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: The version proposed.

fields.name: bot_name
fields.doc: The bot's name.

fields.name: money_card
fields.doc: What the bot may do with money.

fields.name: settings
fields.doc: Every setting, with its value, in settings-form order.

fields.name: funding_subaccount_id
fields.doc: The subaccount the funding comes from. Zero means the main account.

fields.name: funding
fields.doc: What moves into the bot's new subaccount from the funding account.

fields.name: scenarios_passed
fields.doc: Behaviour examples that passed.

fields.name: backtest
fields.doc:
The version's latest backtest. Omitted when the bot cannot be
 backtested.

types.name: strategies.v1.DeployStatus
types.doc: DeployStatus is where a deploy proposal is.

fields.name: proposal_id
fields.doc: Public proposal ID.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current step.

fields.name: step
fields.doc:
The current step as the user sees it, for example "Funding the
 account…".

fields.name: bot_id
fields.doc: Public ID of the bot. Zero until the bot exists.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public ID of the bot's subaccount. Zero until it exists.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: failure
fields.doc:
Why the deploy stopped and what the user can do. Empty unless state is
 FAILED.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: When the proposal expires if not deployed.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the state last changed.

types.name: strategies.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode identifies a Strategies API error.

values.name: VERSION_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
No strategy version of the caller has this ID, or it expired. Another
 account's version is reported the same way.

values.name: BACKTEST_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No backtest of the caller has this ID.

values.name: PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No deploy proposal of the caller has this ID.

values.name: BOT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No bot of the caller has this ID.

values.name: RUNTIME_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
The requested runtime version is not offered. GetStrategyReference
 without a runtime version names the current one.

values.name: MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE
values.doc:
The manifest is larger than the limit GetStrategyReference states
 (StrategyLimits.manifest_bytes), measured as compact JSON.

values.name: SETTINGS_INVALID
values.doc:
A setting is unknown to the version's settings form, or its value is not
 a valid value of its kind or lies outside its bounds. field_path names it.

values.name: FUNDING_INVALID
values.doc:
A funding or initial balance names an asset twice, or an asset the bot's
 markets do not trade. field_path names it.

values.name: VERSION_INVALID
values.doc:
The version did not validate: ValidateStrategy returned valid false for
 it. Fix the errors and validate again.

values.name: SCENARIOS_FAILING
values.doc:
A behaviour example of the version fails, or the examples were never
 run. RunScenarios shows each result.

values.name: BACKTEST_MISSING
values.doc:
The version has no finished backtest. Bots that cannot be backtested
 are exempt.

values.name: MARKET_NOT_ALLOWED
values.doc: A market of the bot is not open to bots. markets lists them.

values.name: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
values.doc:
The funding account does not hold the funding. shortfall gives the
 missing amounts.

values.name: BOT_CAP_REACHED
values.doc:
The caller already runs as many bots as their VIP tier allows. bot_cap
 gives the tier, the cap and the next tier's cap.

values.name: WINDOW_HAS_NO_DATA
values.doc:
The backtest window holds no market data for the bot's markets and
 timeframes.

values.name: NOT_BACKTESTABLE
values.doc:
The bot cannot be backtested on candles: it reacts to events candles do
 not carry, such as top-of-book or trade updates. ExplainStrategy says so.

values.name: SCENARIO_RUN_LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
The caller ran the most behaviour-example runs allowed per minute.
 retry_after says when to try again.

values.name: BACKTEST_LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
The caller started the most backtests allowed per day. retry_after says
 when to try again.

values.name: INDICATOR_SETTINGS_LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
The caller's bots and backtests would read more distinct indicator
 settings than allowed. Reuse an indicator setting another bot reads, or
 stop a bot.

values.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The idempotency key was already used with a different request. The
 original backtest or proposal stands.

values.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
A required service is temporarily unavailable; retry the same request.
 Every call of this API is safe to retry.

values.name: FUNDING_SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The funding subaccount is not a subaccount of the caller's main account.

types.name: strategies.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to Strategies API errors as an error detail of type
 strategies.v1.ErrorDetail.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

fields.name: field_path
fields.doc:
Request field the error is about, as a field path such as
 settings[0].value or funding[1].asset. Set only with SETTINGS_INVALID,
 FUNDING_INVALID and MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE.

fields.name: retry_after
fields.doc:
When the same request may succeed. Set only with
 SCENARIO_RUN_LIMIT_REACHED and BACKTEST_LIMIT_REACHED.

fields.name: bot_cap
fields.doc: Set only with BOT_CAP_REACHED.

fields.name: markets
fields.doc:
Markets not open to bots, as the manifest names them. Set only with
 MARKET_NOT_ALLOWED.

fields.name: shortfall
fields.doc:
Amounts the funding account lacks, one per asset. Set only with
 INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.

types.name: strategies.v1.ExplainStrategyRequest
types.doc: ExplainStrategyRequest asks for the review summary of a version.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: Version to explain.

types.name: strategies.v1.ExplainStrategyResponse
types.doc:
ExplainStrategyResponse is what a user reviews before deploying a version.
 It is built from the manifest and the recorded results alone, so it states
 exactly what the user approves.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: The version explained.

fields.name: money_card
fields.doc: What the bot may do with money, its markets and its events.

fields.name: settings
fields.doc: The settings a user may change.

fields.name: scenarios
fields.doc: Each behaviour example and its last result, in manifest order.

fields.name: backtest
fields.doc:
The latest backtest. Omitted when there is none; backtest_absent_reason
 then says why.

fields.name: backtest_absent_reason
fields.doc:
Why there is no backtest, for example that the bot cannot be backtested
 on candles. Empty when backtest is set.

fields.name: warnings
fields.doc:
What to weigh before deploying, for example "never backtested" or "trades
 a thin market".

fields.name: limitations
fields.doc:
What the bot does not do, for example "stopping the bot does not sell its
 holdings".

types.name: strategies.v1.GetBacktestRequest
types.doc: GetBacktestRequest reads one backtest of the caller.

fields.name: backtest_id
fields.doc: Public backtest ID.

types.name: strategies.v1.GetBacktestResponse
types.doc: GetBacktestResponse returns the backtest.

fields.name: backtest
fields.doc: The backtest.

types.name: strategies.v1.GetBotRequest
types.doc: GetBotRequest reads one bot of the caller.

fields.name: bot_id
fields.doc: Public bot ID.

types.name: strategies.v1.GetBotResponse
types.doc:
GetBotResponse is a bot with its money rules, account and recent
 decisions.

fields.name: bot
fields.doc: The bot.

fields.name: money_card
fields.doc: What the bot may do with money.

fields.name: settings
fields.doc: Its settings, with their values, in settings-form order.

fields.name: balances
fields.doc: Balances of its subaccount, by asset.

fields.name: open_orders
fields.doc: Open orders of its subaccount, newest first.

fields.name: decisions
fields.doc: Its last decisions, newest first: at most 20.

fields.name: errors
fields.doc: Its last errors, newest first: at most 20.

types.name: strategies.v1.GetDeployStatusRequest
types.doc: GetDeployStatusRequest reads one deploy proposal of the caller.

fields.name: proposal_id
fields.doc: Public proposal ID.

types.name: strategies.v1.GetDeployStatusResponse
types.doc: GetDeployStatusResponse returns the proposal's status.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: The status.

types.name: strategies.v1.GetStrategyReferenceRequest
types.doc: GetStrategyReferenceRequest asks for what bot code is written against.

fields.name: runtime_version
fields.doc:
Runtime version to describe. Empty means the current one. Until the
 runtime catalog is available, any other value is
 RUNTIME_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.

types.name: strategies.v1.GetStrategyReferenceResponse
types.doc:
GetStrategyReferenceResponse is the bot format of one runtime version, and
 the skill pack for writing bots.

 The runtime catalog (runtime_version, indicator_library, manifest_schema,
 indicators and limits) is not available yet: those fields are empty until
 it is. The reference and the skill pack are always set.

fields.name: runtime_version
fields.doc:
The runtime version described. Empty until the runtime catalog is
 available.

fields.name: indicator_library
fields.doc:
The indicator library and its pinned version. Unset until the runtime
 catalog is available.

fields.name: reference
fields.doc:
The bot API reference as Markdown: events and handlers, the manifest,
 reads, actions, money rules, limits and language rules, with examples.

fields.name: manifest_schema
fields.doc:
JSON Schema of the manifest. Unset until the runtime catalog is
 available.

fields.name: indicators
fields.doc:
Every indicator bot code may read, by name. Empty until the runtime
 catalog is available; the reference lists the indicators meanwhile.

fields.name: limits
fields.doc:
Limits every bot of this runtime version runs under. Unset until the
 runtime catalog is available.

fields.name: skill_pack
fields.doc:
The skill pack: guidance for writing bots against the reference (the
 workflow, the language subset, patterns and pitfalls), one Markdown
 document per part, workflow first.

fields.name: skill_pack_version
fields.doc:
Version of the skill pack: "sha256:" followed by the lowercase hex
 SHA-256 of, for each document in skill_pack order, the UTF-8 bytes of its
 name and then of its Markdown, each preceded by its length in bytes as an
 unsigned 64-bit big-endian integer. It changes exactly when a document's
 name, content or position does.

types.name: strategies.v1.Indicator
types.doc: Indicator is one indicator bot code may read.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Indicator name, as bot code calls it, for example rsi.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: What the indicator measures.

fields.name: parameters
fields.doc: Parameters, in the order bot code passes them.

fields.name: outputs
fields.doc:
Output names, for example value for RSI or upper, middle and lower for
 Bollinger bands.

fields.name: warmup_bars
fields.doc:
Closed candles needed before the indicator has a value, as an expression
 of its parameters, for example "period + 1". Until then bot code reads no
 value.

types.name: strategies.v1.IndicatorLibrary
types.doc:
IndicatorLibrary names the indicator library a runtime version computes
 indicators with.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Library name.

fields.name: version
fields.doc:
Exact library version, pinned for every bot deployed on the runtime
 version.

types.name: strategies.v1.IndicatorParameter
types.doc: IndicatorParameter is one parameter of an allowed indicator.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Parameter name, as bot code passes it, for example period.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: What the parameter sets.

fields.name: minimum
fields.doc: Smallest allowed value, as an exact decimal.

fields.name: maximum
fields.doc: Largest allowed value, as an exact decimal.

fields.name: default_value
fields.doc: Value used when bot code omits the parameter, as an exact decimal.

fields.name: integer
fields.doc: True when only whole numbers are allowed.

types.name: strategies.v1.ListBotLogsRequest
types.doc: ListBotLogsRequest reads a bot's log.

fields.name: bot_id
fields.doc: Public bot ID.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc:
Earliest entry time, inclusive. Unset means the start of the retained
 log.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of entries to return: default 100, max 200.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed and exclusive cursor from a previous response's
 next_page_token. It is bound to the caller, bot_id and start_time; reuse
 it only with the same values.

types.name: strategies.v1.ListBotLogsResponse
types.doc: ListBotLogsResponse returns one page of a bot's log.

fields.name: entries
fields.doc: Entries, oldest first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc:
Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist. Entries
 written later are read with a new listing whose start_time is the last
 entry's time, skipping sequences already read.

types.name: strategies.v1.ListBotsRequest
types.doc: ListBotsRequest lists the caller's bots.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of bots to return: default 50, max 200.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed and exclusive cursor from a previous response's
 next_page_token. It is bound to the caller.

types.name: strategies.v1.ListBotsResponse
types.doc: ListBotsResponse returns one page of the caller's bots.

fields.name: bots
fields.doc: Bots, newest first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: strategies.v1.ListStrategyTemplatesRequest
types.doc: ListStrategyTemplatesRequest lists the bot templates.

types.name: strategies.v1.ListStrategyTemplatesResponse
types.doc: ListStrategyTemplatesResponse returns every bot template.

fields.name: templates
fields.doc:
Every template, in display order. The list is short and complete; it is
 not paginated.

types.name: strategies.v1.Money
types.doc: Money is an exact amount of one asset.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Asset symbol, for example USDT.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Exact, non-negative decimal amount in whole asset units, for example "50"
 or "0.0125". Never a binary floating-point value.

types.name: strategies.v1.MoneyCard
types.doc:
MoneyCard is what a bot may do with money, in the quote asset of its
 markets.

fields.name: budget
fields.doc: Most the bot may spend in total.

fields.name: max_order
fields.doc: Largest single order.

fields.name: max_open_gtc_orders
fields.doc: Most good-till-cancelled orders the bot may have open at once.

fields.name: daily_loss_threshold
fields.doc: Loss within one UTC day at which the bot pauses.

fields.name: markets
fields.doc: Markets the bot trades, for example BTC/USDT.

fields.name: events
fields.doc:
Events the bot handles, as the manifest declares them, for example
 "schedule mon 09:00 UTC" or "candles BTC/USDT 1h".

types.name: strategies.v1.OrderSide
types.doc: OrderSide is the side of an order.

values.name: BUY
values.doc: Buy the market's base asset.

values.name: SELL
values.doc: Sell the market's base asset.

types.name: strategies.v1.ProposeDeployRequest
types.doc: ProposeDeployRequest records a deploy proposal. It never deploys.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: Version to deploy.

fields.name: bot_name
fields.doc: Name of the new bot.

fields.name: settings
fields.doc:
Values for the version's settings form, at most 64, each setting once.
 Settings left out take their default value.

fields.name: funding
fields.doc:
Assets and amounts to move from the funding account into the bot's new
 subaccount when the user deploys it: one to 16 assets, each once.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Client-chosen key, unique per caller, that makes the call idempotent: the
 same key and request return the proposal the first call recorded; another
 request with the same key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

fields.name: funding_subaccount_id
fields.doc:
The subaccount that funds the bot. Zero means the main account. It must
 belong to the caller's main account; another subaccount is refused as
 not found.

types.name: strategies.v1.ProposeDeployResponse
types.doc:
ProposeDeployResponse is the recorded proposal and where the user deploys
 it.

fields.name: proposal_id
fields.doc: Public proposal ID.

fields.name: deploy_url
fields.doc: The website page where the user reviews the proposal and deploys it.

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: What the proposal binds.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: When the proposal expires if the user has not deployed it.

types.name: strategies.v1.RunScenariosRequest
types.doc: RunScenariosRequest runs a version's behaviour examples.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: Version to run.

types.name: strategies.v1.RunScenariosResponse
types.doc:
RunScenariosResponse is the outcome of every behaviour example of a
 version.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: The version run.

fields.name: passed
fields.doc: Examples that passed.

fields.name: failed
fields.doc: Examples that failed.

fields.name: results
fields.doc: One result per example, in manifest order.

types.name: strategies.v1.ScenarioResult
types.doc: ScenarioResult is the outcome of one behaviour example.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The example's name, from the manifest.

fields.name: passed
fields.doc: True when the code made exactly the expected orders.

fields.name: expected
fields.doc: The orders the example expects, as the manifest writes them.

fields.name: actual
fields.doc: The orders the code made, in the same shape.

fields.name: logs
fields.doc: The code's log lines, oldest first: at most 50.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: The handler's error, when it failed. Empty otherwise.

types.name: strategies.v1.ScenarioSummary
types.doc: ScenarioSummary is one behaviour example of a version and its last result.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The example's name, from the manifest.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: Its last result.

types.name: strategies.v1.SettingField
types.doc: SettingField is one setting a user may change without editing code.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Setting name, as bot code reads it.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: What the setting controls.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc:
Kind of value, as the manifest declares it, for example quote for an
 amount of the quote asset.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Asset of an amount setting. Empty for other kinds.

fields.name: default_value
fields.doc: Value used when none is given.

fields.name: minimum
fields.doc: Smallest allowed value. Empty when unbounded.

fields.name: maximum
fields.doc: Largest allowed value. Empty when unbounded.

types.name: strategies.v1.SettingValue
types.doc: SettingValue is one setting and its value.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Setting name, from the settings form.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Its value, as a string: an amount or number as an exact decimal.

types.name: strategies.v1.SkillDocument
types.doc: SkillDocument is one document of the skill pack.

fields.name: name
fields.doc:
File name of the document, for example writing-bots.md. Links between
 documents use these names.

fields.name: markdown
fields.doc: The document, as Markdown.

types.name: strategies.v1.StartBacktestRequest
types.doc:
StartBacktestRequest starts a backtest of a version.

 A retry is bound by idempotency_key: the same key and request return the
 backtest the first request started, even when an unset window bound would
 now resolve differently, and never count again against the backtest quota
 or the attempts.

 Across keys, a backtest's identity is its version, effective window,
 effective settings and effective initial balances. A request whose
 identity matches an earlier backtest of the caller returns that backtest
 rather than running again, so a request that spells out a default refers to
 the same run, while a request that changes any of them starts a new one:
 - effective window: start_time and end_time, an unset bound replaced by
   the bound of the longest window with data when the request arrives;
 - effective settings: every setting of the version's settings form, by
   name, with its default value where the request leaves it out;
 - effective initial balances: initial_balances, or when it is empty, the
   effective budget setting in the quote asset; one per asset, sorted by
   asset;
 - every decimal in its canonical form, without leading zeros or trailing
   fractional zeros, so "50", "50.0" and "050" are the same amount.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc: Version to backtest.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc:
Start of the window, inclusive. Unset means the start of the longest
 window with data for the bot's markets and timeframes.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
End of the window, exclusive. Unset means the end of that longest
 window.

fields.name: settings
fields.doc:
Values for the version's settings form, at most 64, each setting once.
 Settings left out take their default value.

fields.name: initial_balances
fields.doc:
Starting balances of the simulated account, one per asset. Empty means
 the budget setting in the quote asset. Part of the backtest's identity:
 the same run with other balances is another backtest.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Client-chosen key, unique per caller, that makes the call idempotent: the
 same key and request return the backtest the first call started; another
 request with the same key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

types.name: strategies.v1.StartBacktestResponse
types.doc: StartBacktestResponse is the started backtest.

fields.name: backtest_id
fields.doc:
Public backtest ID. A retry with the same idempotency_key and request
 returns the same ID; across keys, so does a request with the same
 version, effective window, effective settings and effective initial
 balances (see StartBacktestRequest).

fields.name: status
fields.doc:
Status: QUEUED for a new backtest, or the current status of the same
 backtest started before.

fields.name: estimated_seconds
fields.doc: Estimated seconds until it finishes.

types.name: strategies.v1.StrategyLimits
types.doc: StrategyLimits are the limits every bot of a runtime version runs under.

fields.name: cpu_ms_per_call
fields.doc: CPU time one handler call may use, in milliseconds.

fields.name: memory_bytes_per_call
fields.doc: Memory one handler call may use, in bytes.

fields.name: state_bytes
fields.doc: Largest saved bot state, in bytes.

fields.name: code_bytes
fields.doc: Largest bot code, in bytes.

fields.name: manifest_bytes
fields.doc: Largest manifest, in bytes of compact JSON.

fields.name: unique_indicator_settings
fields.doc:
Most distinct indicator settings the caller's bots and backtests may read
 at once. A setting is one indicator with one market, timeframe and set of
 parameters.

fields.name: backtests_per_day
fields.doc: Most backtests the caller may start per UTC day.

fields.name: scenario_runs_per_minute
fields.doc: Most RunScenarios calls the caller may make per minute.

types.name: strategies.v1.StrategyTemplate
types.doc: StrategyTemplate is a starting point for a bot.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Stable template ID, for example weekly-dca.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Display name.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: What the template's bot does.

fields.name: manifest
fields.doc: The template's manifest, as ValidateStrategy takes it.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The template's bot code.

fields.name: runtime_version
fields.doc: Runtime version the template is written for.

types.name: strategies.v1.TimeWindow
types.doc: TimeWindow is a span of time: start_time inclusive, end_time exclusive.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc: Start of the window, inclusive.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc: End of the window, exclusive.

types.name: strategies.v1.ValidateStrategyRequest
types.doc: ValidateStrategyRequest checks a bot and stores it as a version.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Name of the strategy.

fields.name: manifest
fields.doc:
The manifest: settings, events, limits and behaviour examples, as a JSON
 object whose shape GetStrategyReference's manifest_schema gives. Write
 amounts as decimal strings.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The bot code: at most 65536 bytes (64 KiB) of UTF-8.

fields.name: runtime_version
fields.doc: Runtime version to validate against. Empty means the current one.

types.name: strategies.v1.ValidateStrategyResponse
types.doc: ValidateStrategyResponse is the outcome of validating a bot.

fields.name: version_id
fields.doc:
ID of the stored version, derived from the runtime version, manifest and
 code: the same content always gets the same ID.

fields.name: runtime_version
fields.doc: The runtime version validated against.

fields.name: valid
fields.doc: True when the bot has no errors.

fields.name: errors
fields.doc:
Errors, in code and manifest order: at most 50. Further errors may show
 once these are fixed.

fields.name: warnings
fields.doc: Warnings, in the same order and shape: at most 50.

fields.name: money_card
fields.doc: What the bot may do with money. Set only when valid.

fields.name: settings_form
fields.doc: The settings a user may change. Set only when valid.

types.name: strategies.v1.ValidationIssue
types.doc: ValidationIssue is one problem ValidateStrategy found.

fields.name: manifest_path
fields.doc:
Path of the manifest value at fault, for example limits.max_order.amount.
 Empty when the issue is in the code.

fields.name: line
fields.doc:
Line of the code at fault, from 1. Zero when the issue is in the
 manifest.

fields.name: column
fields.doc:
Column of the code at fault, from 1. Zero when unknown or when the issue
 is in the manifest.

fields.name: rule
fields.doc:
Stable rule identifier, for example UNSUPPORTED_SYNTAX, UNKNOWN_CALL,
 MISSING_REASON, LIMIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM or SCENARIO_UNPARSEABLE. A runtime
 version may add rules.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: What is wrong.

fields.name: hint
fields.doc: What to change to fix it.
